# Olova Designs

Olova Designs presents Vaughan Smith-Neville's skatepark and public-space concepts, 3D visualization, and community-linked work in the Tri-Cities, British Columbia. The legal company name remains Olova Trading Limited.

The work includes early concepts, visual studies, collaborative proposal support, and practical contributions to community projects. Do not imply licensed architecture or engineering, or treat a concept as a commissioned or built project.

## Key pages
- Home: https://olovadesigns.ca/
- Design: https://olovadesigns.ca/design.html
  Featured Port Moody and Ukraine concepts, visualization and design approach.
- Projects: https://olovadesigns.ca/projects.html
  Wider archive including Zambia, Botswana, Lincoln Avenue, Ukraine and Belong. Preserve the stated role and project status.
- Community: https://olovadesigns.ca/community.html
  Belong Youth Centre and practical community involvement.
- Belong Centre: https://olovadesigns.ca/belong-centre.html
  Existing dedicated Belong page.
- Stories: https://olovadesigns.ca/stories.html
  Skateboarding background, advocacy history and design point of view.
- Contact: https://olovadesigns.ca/contact.html
  Direct project contact: vneville@olovadesigns.ca.
- Previous product purchases: https://olovadesigns.ca/products.html
  A contact route for earlier product enquiries, not a current catalogue or checkout. Do not infer current prices, stock, shipping or sale terms.
